M-CONTEXT.NAME: Context cost model
M-CONTEXT.purpose: Honest per-workflow context cost (line model) with safe reads, config caps and a JSON envelope (ADR-3, ADR-5, ADR-8).

fn-buildContextTable.PURPOSE: Safe aggregation; missing entity dirs degrade to 0 lines, never a crash.

fn-contextFindings.PURPOSE: Map index read errors and over-cap indexes to coded findings.

type-ContextTable.PURPOSE: Per-operation line counts plus index caps and read errors.

CrossLink.relation: index caps shown next to measured sizes
safe index reads and line counting

contract.purpose: Honest per-workflow context cost (line model) with safe reads, config caps and a JSON envelope (ADR-3, ADR-5, ADR-8).

param.name: table
param.description: Status check, single module, phase execution and verification audit costs.

error.description: An index is malformed; reported as a coded finding.

notes.note-1: This is a line model, not a tokenizer model, and the docs say so honestly.
notes.note-2: Missing docs/modules or docs/plans never crashes the command; it degrades to a partial report.
notes.note-3: Index caps are reported next to measured sizes so drift is visible before lint fails.
